_note: BykonzYard comp-swap spec, 18 Sep 2026. Every entry is a surface Shaan named as not good enough, with the MEASURED defect (headless Chromium, 390x844) and the bank tags to pick a replacement from. Rule: rob a comp, do not hand-roll CSS.

surfaces.label: Follow the archive / Watch the sets
surfaces.quote: the thumbnail is too small, too much text, text is too big
surfaces.measured: card 283-290px tall, thumbnail only 85-93px of it, title 16px wrapping to 5-6 LINES
surfaces.accept: thumbnail >= 55% of card height, title <= 2 lines, card <= 45vh

surfaces.label: Gallery archive cards
surfaces.quote: archive cards are terrible on the photo gallery, too small
surfaces.measured: 13 cards at 148px tall, image only 77px — image is half the card, rest is chrome
surfaces.accept: image >= 70% of card, 167 real photos available from bykonz-photos.pages.dev

surfaces.label: Next event flyer card
surfaces.quote: the new events card's too big, it's not very nice, it's because of the image there, you don't need that image
surfaces.measured: flyer image dominates; ticket-info-links block 248px for 18 words
surfaces.accept: no full-bleed flyer image; date/venue/price legible without scrolling the card

surfaces.label: Ask the Yard chat popup
surfaces.quote: the chat UI popup still isn't been sorted, I wanted a GitHub repo which does this feature out of the box
surfaces.measured: @assistant-ui/react 0.15.20 IS installed (the out-of-the-box repo) but styled with 59 lines of hand-rolled CSS. @assistant-ui/styles 0.3.7 exists upstream and is NOT installed.
surfaces.accept: adopt @assistant-ui/styles OR a 21st chat shell; delete ask-yard.css hand-rolling

surfaces.label: Contact / booking form
surfaces.quote: the guy wants us to put the email code in there, dropdown country code, the form could be nicer, shadcn ui or 21st.dev
surfaces.measured: form is 913px tall = 108vh — taller than the phone screen, for 65 words
surfaces.accept: country-code dropdown on the phone field; form <= 80vh

surfaces.label: Yard store reward cards
surfaces.quote: on the rewards just feel like they could be some
surfaces.measured: 6 cards at 494px = 59vh each, but image only 73px of that

surfaces.label: Earn 3-step rail + Join the yard
surfaces.quote: the three do the stuff could be nicer, Join the yard doesn't pop out as much as it should
surfaces.measured: 3 steps at 224px = 27vh each on a snap rail; Join the yard is a plain text link
surfaces.accept: all 3 steps visible without horizontal scroll; Join the yard reads as a primary CTA

surfaces.label: About mission cards
surfaces.quote: the three cards here could have robbed from 21st or shadcn and UI would have been way nicer
surfaces.measured: 3 cards at 230px = 27vh, no image, 14 words each — plain bordered boxes
surfaces.accept: cards carry visual weight (border/gradient/image treatment), not plain boxes

keep.quote: I like the way you've done the background, that's really cool, you can use more of our images for stuff like that
the about page is all right... the mission title and subtext is alright
the cards are better though on the rewards
